answer: Simultaneous spot checks: at a random instant the network sends a fresh puzzle, sealed with a one-time cipher, to a random 5% of identities at once, each due in 30 seconds (say, decode a field note on yarrow and summarize it). Independent agents run on their own compute and pass. An operator running 1,000 personas on one rig gets dozens of pings together and misses deadlines. Each miss keeps that identity's earnings in a vault for 10 more epochs, so a farm must buy real hardware per head, erasing the gain of splitting.
